name: convert_script
title: Convert between Indian scripts
description: Rewrites text from one Indian script into another letter by letter, e.g. Devanagari 'नमस्ते' → Kannada 'ನಮಸ್ತೇ'. The language does not change, only the letters. Works between the Brahmic scripts (Devanagari, Bengali, Gurmukhi, Gujarati, Odia, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam) and Meetei Mayek; sounds the target script lacks use the nearest letter. Text in other scripts is kept as it is.

text.description: Text in any Brahmic script or Meetei Mayek.

targetLanguage.description: Language whose script to convert into, e.g. 'ta', 'Telugu', 'mni'.

name: get_keymap
title: Get phonetic keyboard map
description: Returns the phonetic keyboard map for a language: which Latin keys produce each letter. Useful for teaching someone to type a language or for building correct romanised input for transliterate.

name: list_languages
title: List Indian languages
description: Lists the 22 scheduled languages of India (plus extra official scripts for Kashmiri, Manipuri and Sindhi) with the codes the other tools accept.

name: native_digits
title: Write digits in a native script
description: Replaces ASCII digits 0-9 with a language's native digits, e.g. '2026' → '२०२६' (Hindi), '௨௦௨௬' (Tamil), '۲۰۲۶' (Urdu).

annotations.title: Write digits in a native script

name: translate
title: Translate text
description: Translates the meaning of text between English and the 22 scheduled languages of India, or between two of them, e.g. 'Where is the station?' → 'स्टेशन कहाँ है?' (Hindi). English → Indic uses AI4Bharat IndicTrans2; Indic → English uses Gemma 4; Indic → Indic goes through English. Free use: up to 2,000 characters per call, 5 calls a minute and 10,000 characters a day. Unlike the other tools this sends the text to Bhasini's server (mcp.bhasini.com); the text is not stored. To write romanised words in a script by sound, use transliterate instead.

text.description: Text to translate. Line breaks are kept.

targetLanguage.description: Language to translate into: a code or name from list_languages, or 'en' for English.

sourceLanguage.description: Language of the text, or 'auto' (default) to detect it.

name: transliterate
title: Transliterate romanised text
description: Writes romanised (Latin-letter) text in an Indian script by sound, e.g. 'namaste' → 'नमस्ते' for Hindi or 'vaNakkam' → 'வணக்கம்' for Tamil. This is transliteration, not translation: spell the words as they sound in the target language. Keys follow ITRANS/Baraha conventions: capitals for long vowels and retroflex consonants (A I U E O, T D N L Sh), M = anusvara, H = visarga. Use get_keymap for a language's exact keys.

text.description: Romanised text to transliterate. Punctuation, digits and spaces are kept.

language.description: Target language code or name, e.g. 'hi', 'ta', 'kn', 'Bengali', 'sat' (Santali, Ol Chiki).
